questions.q: ___ I want is a cup of tea and some peace and quiet.
questions.why: «Усе, що» — *All I want is…* (або *All that I want*). *All what* — помилка; *That all* і *All of what* — неграматично.

questions.q: What I did ___ call the police.
questions.why: Виділення дії — *What I did was (to) call*. *it was* — зайвий займенник; *did* — неграматично; *was that* — після *what … do* не вживають.

questions.q: What happened ___ the lift got stuck between floors.
questions.why: Виділення події — *What happened was (that)…* *it was* і *was it* — зайвий займенник чи питальний порядок; *did* — неграматично.

questions.q: A good night's sleep is ___ you need.
questions.why: Зворотне виділення — *X is what you need*. *that* і *which* — потребують іменника перед собою; *all what* — помилка.

questions.q: It was only when I got home ___ I realised I'd lost my wallet.
questions.why: It-виділення — *It was only when… that…* *when* — подвоєння; *then* — «тоді», не сполучник; *which* — означальне.

questions.q: It's not that I don't like him — it's ___ we have nothing in common.
questions.why: *It's not that…, it's just that…* — справа не в тому, а в тому. *just because* — інша конструкція; *only so* і *that just* — неграматично.

questions.q: ___ is, I can't afford a new car right now.
questions.why: Розмовне *The thing is, …* *The thing what* і *The thing it* — зайві слова; *What thing is* — питання.

questions.q: That's ___ I didn't tell you — I knew you'd be upset.
questions.why: Причина в зворотному виділенні — *That's why*. *what* — «те, що»; *because* — після *That's* так не вживають; *which* — означальне.

questions.q: It was not ___ she left school that she started painting.
questions.why: *It was not until… that…* — лише після того. *not when* і *not since* — інший зміст; *before when* — неграматично.

questions.q: All you have to do ___ fill in this form.
questions.why: *All you have to do is (to) fill in*. *are* — множина; *is that* — неграматично тут; *it is* — зайвий займенник.
Зворотне виділення місця — *This is where…* *what* — «те, що»; *which* і *that* — потребують прийменника (*in*).

questions.q: If anyone is to blame, ___ me.
questions.why: *If anyone is to blame, it's me.* *it was being* — неправильний час; *that is it* і *is it* — неграматично тут.

questions.q: ___ I really need now is a holiday.
questions.why: Виділення — *What I need is…* (також *All / All that*).

questions.q: The reason I called ___ that I need your advice.
There's something I ___ to tell you.
questions.why: There-виділення: *There's something I need to tell you*.

questions.q: What she's doing ___ trying to save the company.

answer: All I want is a quiet life
questions.why: *All I want is…* — «усе, що я хочу, — це…».

answer: What happened was that the car broke down
